## getBot

Get Bot Kb Folders. `GET /knowledge-base/bots/{bot_id}/kb-folders`

Get KB folder configuration for a bot.

Returns list of folders the bot uses for knowledge base search. If empty, bot searches all folders.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbFolders()->getBot(botId: 'bot_id');
```

- Scopes: `automation:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$botId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `BotKbFolders`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Folders/get_bot_kb_folders_api_v1_knowledge_base_bots__bot_id__kb_folders_get)

## setBot

Set Bot Kb Folders. `PUT /knowledge-base/bots/{bot_id}/kb-folders`

Set KB folder configuration for a bot.

Replaces any existing folder assignments. To search all folders, pass an empty list.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbFolders()->setBot(botId: 'bot_id', folders: []);
```

- Scopes: `automation:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$botId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$folders` | `list<array<string, mixed>>` | yes | List of folder configurations for the bot |

Returns `BotKbFolders`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Folders/set_bot_kb_folders_api_v1_knowledge_base_bots__bot_id__kb_folders_put)

## list

List Folders. `GET /knowledge-base/folders`

List all folders as a tree structure.

Returns hierarchical folder structure with document counts. System folders (General, Websites, Ticket Summaries) are auto-created.

```php

```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

Returns `KbFolderTree`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Folders/list_folders_api_v1_knowledge_base_folders_get)

## create

Create Folder. `POST /knowledge-base/folders`

Create a new folder.

System folders cannot be created via API. Maximum folder depth is 3 levels.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbFolders()->create(name: 'name');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Folder name |
| `$parentId` | `?string` | no | Parent folder ID. NULL for root-level folders. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `KbFolder`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Folders/create_folder_api_v1_knowledge_base_folders_post)
